headline: Keep cand_0002's levers; add a no-stall execution rule, partial-transfer rule, cabin-in-place rule, account-holder dob guard, conditional-fallback rule, and cancel-original-on-replace rule.

clusters.name: Described-but-unexecuted write (stall)
clusters.detail: Agent presents a fully-specified change and asks 'reply yes'; the user replies 'yes###STOP###' and the episode ends before the write runs, so a required DB write never happens.

clusters.name: Wholesale transfer on a mixed-feasibility task
clusters.detail: When some bundled requests are infeasible (ineligible/flown cancel), the agent transfers to a human for everything and skips the feasible writes it could have made.

clusters.name: Cabin change done as cancel+rebook
clusters.detail: Agent creates a NEW reservation to change cabin instead of in-place update_reservation_flights, over-applying 'basic economy flights cannot be modified' to the cabin.

clusters.name: Wrong dob when passenger becomes a different person
clusters.detail: Replacing a passenger with the account holder, the agent reuses the replaced passenger's dob instead of the new person's real (profile) dob, corrupting the DB.

clusters.name: Conditional fallback fired on wrong trigger
clusters.detail: A fallback gated on price>$500 is triggered by an unrelated obstacle (no seats), dropping a passenger the user still wanted.

clusters.name: Replace-with-new-bookings leaves original uncancelled
clusters.detail: Splitting a reservation into new bookings (one certificate each) without cancelling the original leaves both old and new records in the DB.
